name: twenty
description: The open alternative to Salesforce, designed for AI.
one_liner: A free, open alternative to Salesforce — a customer and sales tracker a small business can run and customize itself instead of paying per-seat software fees.
buyer: A small business owner or sales manager who's been quoted Salesforce/HubSpot pricing and can't justify the per-seat cost for a 5-10 person sales team.
business_use_cases: A small B2B services company replaces a $50/seat/month CRM with a self-hosted Twenty instance, saving thousands a year.
A real estate brokerage customizes Twenty's objects and fields to track listings, buyers, and showings instead of paying for an industry-specific CRM.
A boutique recruiting agency builds a custom pipeline view in Twenty to track candidates and client companies in one system.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'CRM setup and customization' as a fixed-price service for small businesses who want Twenty self-hosted but don't want to touch Docker themselves.
Build and sell industry-specific object/field templates (e.g. a real-estate or restaurant-supplier pack) on top of Twenty's open core.

steal_this: Package a one-click 'Twenty for [industry]' setup — pre-built objects, fields, and views for a specific small-business vertical — and sell the install + onboarding as a flat-fee weekend service.
